core_obligations: By lemma-sheaf-differentials (applicable by assumptions (1) and (2)) the sheaf of differentials of the morphism R to U is free. By assumption (3) the field k has characteristic zero, so varieties-lemma-char-zero-differentials-free-smooth applies to the locally finite type morphism R to U with free sheaf of differentials and gives that R to U is smooth. Conclusion: both s and t are smooth.
proof_roadmap: Get freeness of the sheaf of differentials of R to U from lemma-sheaf-differentials (proof lines 1631-1633).
Apply the characteristic zero smoothness criterion to the locally finite type morphism R to U (proof lines 1634-1635).
